speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; to begin our assessment, have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits or stool characteristics?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming the duration and severity of your symptoms. Given the weight loss and night sweats, have you experienced any changes in appetite or difficulty swallowing recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The description of a fixed, non-tender, recently enlarged supraclavicular node alongside systemic symptoms like night sweats, weight loss, and abdominal pain is highly concerning for malignancy. Have you noticed any bleeding, bruising, or changes in your urine or stool color?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LFTs, LDH, ESR, CRP.
REQUEST IMAGES: CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast, CT Chest.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: WBC: Elevated, Hemoglobin: Slightly Decreased, Platelets: Normal, Lactate_Dehydrogenase: Elevated, CT_Scan_Thorax_and_Abdomen: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes, Cervical_Lymph_Node_Biopsy: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL).
